newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Russia buying Argentine sunflower oil -traders.
newsitem.headline: Russia buying Argentine sunflower oil -traders.

text.p: Russia has been in the market for Argentine sunflower seed oil and is looking for more, Argentine traders said Friday.
"We sold 15,500 tonnes of sunflower seed oil for July to the Russians," one trader told Reuters, "In May we sold them 10,500 tonnes and they are looking for more sunseed oil."
The trader declined to give the price of the operations, but said Argentine sunflower seed oil was currently offered at about $533 for July shipment and bid at $523.
The trader said that the Chinese were also in the market seeking 25,000-30,000 tonnes of South American soybean oil for July, while Iran was looking for 20,000-25,000 tonnes.
But traders said that stocks of soyoil were running low in Argentina.
